Do you want to join, and help drive, the growth journey of a leading AI-powered SaaS company in automotive? At Autoflows, you will work side by side with our Head of Norway, Customer Success and the rest of the team to take an established customer base further, win new enterprise deals with some of the world's most iconic automotive brands, their dealers and independent workshop groups, and help shape where we go next in Norway. We are looking for a self-driven, proactive and results-oriented Commercial Manager who is ready to own targets and drive growth. If you want strong personal growth, a powerful network across the automotive and tech industries, and a front-row seat to where AI and SaaS are heading, **this is where your next chapter starts.

**Who We Are

**Autoflows is a fast-scaling SaaS platform transforming how the automotive industry engages customers. Dealers and OEMs face enormous challenges today: shrinking margins, fragmented data, and rising customer expectations. Autoflows is the answer.

• We connect directly to DMS, CRM, and OEM systems to predict, personalize, and automate customer journeys

• We deliver frictionless customer experiences that feel like service rather than marketing

• Our clients achieve proven revenue growth and major efficiency gains, with documented results such as doubling booking volumes, increasing outbound conversion by 125 percent, and delivering a tenfold ROI by removing manual admin tasks

• We are already trusted by partners like Audi, VW, Porsche, SKODA, Peugeot, Kia, Ford, Volvo, and Mercedes-Benz

**The Opportunity

****This Role Is About Ownership And Impact. You Will

**

• Work closely with the Head of Norway to define and execute the go-to-market plan for the Norwegian market

• Own clear sales targets and build a strong pipeline of new business

• Manage and develop our existing customer portfolio in Norway, deepening relationships, expanding usage and securing renewals

• Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close deals with OEMs, dealer groups, and CX leaders

• Work closely with marketing to generate demand through webinars, campaigns, and events

• Bring market insight back to the organisation, helping shape both product development and growth strategy

• Deliver tangible results from the first quarter

**What You Bring

**You are a proven enterprise SaaS salesperson with at least five years of experience, ideally in automotive, customer experience, or analytics. Value-based selling is in your DNA, and you know how to grow existing customers as well as win new ones. You are:

• Fluent in Norwegian and English

• Commercially sharp and resilient, with the creativity to build pipeline

• Consultative and confident managing multiple stakeholders in complex enterprise deals

• Familiar with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDIC

• Self-driven and proactive: you hunt, you build, you win

Note: The role is based at our head office in Copenhagen city centre, where you will be part of the wider commercial team. For the right candidate, we are also open to an Oslo-based setup with regular travel to Copenhagen. Either way, while we work highly efficiently on Teams, you will regularly travel to meet new and existing clients in Norway, attend industry events and more. Let's have a talk and find the best solution together.

**Why Join Autoflows

**This is a chance to join a European scale-up with proven traction, a high-performance culture, and leadership committed to your success.

• Grow your market with direct support from the Head of Norway and a strong sales team

• Sell a product with strong product-market fit and referenceable logos across Europe

• Earn a competitive base salary with an uncapped commission model that rewards growth

• Join a culture that plays to win but also celebrates together. We believe in passion, persistence, and having fun while building something extraordinary

**About Us

**Autoflows is a highly international team of 55 employees with a work culture that is built on four key values: Proactivity, curiosity, ownership and collaboration. We are very customer-centric and highly focused on delivering best-in-class solutions to our customers while learning and developing at the same time. We have an informal and relaxed team atmosphere with team events, breakfasts and Friday bars. Our offices are on Højbro Plads in the very cool start-up community Matrikel 1. You can read more about us here www.autoflows.com.

**How To Apply

**Please include your CV, LinkedIn profile and a short motivational message when you apply. The deadline to apply is 1 November 2026.

**About Our Interview Process

**

• Online or face-to-face introduction to Autoflows and you (30 minutes)

• Case-based interview with team members and the Head of Norway (1 hour)

• Closing talk including compensation, starting date, and all other practical details (30 minutes)

If you are ready to make your mark on the future of automotive customer experience, we would love to hear from you.

If you have questions about this role, please reach out to Head of Norway, Kent Richard Bråthen.

**The Opportunity

**Key Responsibilities

**Qualification & Experience

jobs.description:
_Do you want to join a global fund manager in energy infrastructure investments? If so, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is currently looking for a Team Assistant to join our Investor Relations & Business Development (IR & BD) team based in Copenhagen.

Team

We are seeking a motivated and organized Team Assistant to support our team members in our Investor Relations & Business Development (IR & BD) team. The IR & BD team at CIP is a global, high-performing unit responsible for all investor interactions and business development activities—from product and fund development to fundraising and client engagement. The team comprises approximately 70 professionals from 15 countries, with backgrounds in investment banking, management consulting, and law.

You will be also a part of a broader Executive Support team, and will report to Heidi Jensen, Sr. Personal Assistant.

Role

As a Team Assistant based in CIPs Copenhagen office you will be primarily supporting the EMEA team, within the broader Investor Relations team covering clients across the region. You will play a central role both internally and externally, and you will be the closest go-to person for your team in providing broad administrative support.

Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

• Organizing and maintaining calendars, ensuring alignment in daily schedule and keeping calendars up-to date

• Organizing travel arrangements and logistics and ensuring that roadshows are going smoothly

• Providing broad administrative support, e.g., managing incoming inquiries and scheduling meetings

• Updating CRM systems (e.g., Dealcloud) with relevant data

• Communicating with investors, e.g. replying to emails, sending invitations to events and press releases

You

You have around 5 years of relevant experience in administrative or coordinating roles, preferably from a consulting firm, law firm, investment bank, large international company or a Ministry/Government Agency. You thrive in a high-paced work environment and are motivated, thorough, and resourceful, with a high level of professionalism and able to handle confidential material discreetly.

We look for the following in a candidate

• Solid knowledge of Office 365 applications

• Excellent communication and time management skills

• Ability to balance responsibilities in a busy environment across various projects with changing priorities

• Ability to grasp the big picture at the same time being thorough with a high attention to detail

• Ability to manage administrative processes and projects independently, at the same time enjoying sparring and collaborating with the team

• Resilient, service minded, proactive and with a positive can-do attitude

• Experience with CRM tools is a plus

• Project management – investor events, road shows

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

Building value that matters

Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) today is the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy investments and a global leader in offshore wind. To date, CIP has developed and constructed more than +50 greenfield renewable projects around the world. CIP is developing a greenfield project portfolio of ~160GW total, and ~16 GW is in operation or under construction. CIP manages 13 funds and has to date raised approximately EUR ~35 billion for investments in energy and associated infrastructure from more than ~200 international institutional investors.

CIP has a multinational team of ~500 full-time employees with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

CIP has built a prominent investment team capable of originating proprietary investment opportunities and executing projects and investments based on the team’s industrial background, large industrial network, and extensive experience in structuring, executing, and managing investments within energy infrastructure. Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP also operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Utrecht, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

We’re looking for a commercially minded Legal Counsel to join us on our journey to become one stronger, more integrated SaaS business. You’ll work across commercial contracts, privacy and cybersecurity in the European and North American market, partnering with colleagues across the organisation to find practical solutions and support our growth.

Reporting to our General Counsel, you’ll work at the intersection of commercial law, privacy, cybersecurity and business transformation. You’ll play a key role in enabling business growth, supporting complex customer deals, and ensuring that our legal commitments are practical, proportionate and aligned with how we operate.

Whether you’re building on your experience in private practice or looking to grow further in an in-house role, this is an opportunity for you to take ownership, learn along the way, and make a real difference.

We are open to on-site (offices in Copenhagen and Wrocław), hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET), plus the US East Coast.

**About Us

**Cookie Information, Piwik PRO, and Sheltr, are leading SaaS brands specialising in privacy-first compliance and analytics. Together, we’re building intuitive, user-friendly products that help organisations navigate data privacy and marketing insights. With headquarters in Copenhagen and an office in Wrocław, our teams have been working across various industries to build trusted data privacy solutions since 2011.

We’re bringing our brands closer together to build one company with a shared identity in the group, a clear focus and ambitious plan for the future. The Legal, Compliance and Cybersecurity team has a core role to play in making that happen.

The role

These will be your main tasks:

Handle commercial contracts, particularly sales contracts

• Draft, review and negotiate customer contracts for EU and US customers.

• Support partner, reseller and supplier agreements, as well as more specialised regulatory requirements such as DORA-related terms and US healthcare BAAs.

• Work closely with Sales and Account Management to find solutions that support our commercial goals while managing legal risks.

Privacy compliance and cybersecurity

• Support GDPR compliance, international data transfers, sub-processor management and relevant UK and US privacy requirements.

• Work with our Cybersecurity team on NIS2 compliance and related contractual requirements.

• Help our Cyber Security and Compliance teams to respond to customer privacy and security questionnaires, audits and due diligence requests.

• Advise Product teams on privacy, consent and data protection, helping ensure that our commitments reflect how we actually work.

Help shape the way we work

• Improve legal templates, processes and ways of working as the business grows.

• Collaborate with colleagues across Sales, Product, Security, Finance and Operations.

• Contribute to shaping our legal function and how we support the wider business.

**About You

**You’re a structured, independent, and commercially minded lawyer who enjoys working with people and finding practical solutions. You combine sound legal judgement with a practical understanding of how a business operates. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, thinking creatively and making decisions, even when the answer isn’t entirely straightforward.

You know that good legal advice is not just about identifying risks; it’s about helping the business understand those risks and finding a way forward.

You bring:

• 2-5 years of experience with commercial contracts, gained in-house or at a law firm.

• An understanding of B2B contracting and an interest in SaaS or technology businesses.

• Working knowledge of GDPR and privacy law in a commercial context, or relevant experience with HIPAA and US privacy law.

• The ability to communicate clearly, and comfortable working directly with Sales on live deals and making pragmatic judgement calls.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves

• Experience with cybersecurity regulations (NIS2 and/or DORA).

• Experience with HIPAA, including negotiating BAAs.

• Knowledge of corporate governance, employment/HR legal matters (DK, PL, DE, and/or US).

• Experience with US customers and US commercial contracting, including state privacy laws and/or wiretap/tracking litigation risk.

• Experience building processes and templates in a growing legal function.

What we offer

• The opportunity to make a real impact. You’ll help shape a growing international SaaS business as it evolves towards a more integrated, enterprise-ready organisation. You won’t simply be maintaining existing processes; you’ll help develop the legal and commercial foundations for our next stage of growth.

• International exposure and commercial ownership. You’ll work on customer and partner relationships across the US and Europe, gaining exposure to complex commercial negotiations and a broad range of legal and regulatory challenges.

• The chance to broaden your expertise, take ownership of meaningful projects and grow with the business.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.

This is what our recruitment process looks like:

• A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

• An in-depth interview with the General Counsel and a stakeholder from the company (online)

• A final interview with our General Counsel including a live case (online or in-person, TBD)

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

Are you ready to take ownership of a Nordic service organisation and build a more integrated, efficient and customer-focused operation across Denmark and Sweden? Join Ramcon and play a key role in strengthening service performance, developing people and processes, and supporting profitable growth in a specialized Nordic LabTech and MedTech  business.

Ramcon is a leading Nordic distributor of advanced solutions within Life Science, Healthcare, Medical Technology, Chemistry and Industrial applications. Since 1988, the company has built its market position through strong supplier partnerships, deep technical expertise and long-term customer relationships. Today, Ramcon distributes its products and solutions in Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland and employs approximately 80 employees across Denmark and Sweden. The company operates from offices in Birkerød, Aarhus, Stockholm, and Gothenburg.

Lead and develop the Nordic service organisation

The Service Director Nordic will have overarching responsibility for Ramcon’s Nordic service business and will be a member of the Nordic Leadership Team. The position combines people leadership, operational management and business development, with full P&L responsibility for the service business and responsibility for translating strategic ambitions into efficient operations and measurable results.

With direct responsibility for the Danish service business and overarching leadership of the service organisations in Denmark and Sweden, the Service Director Nordic will work closely with local Service Managers and Service Leaders. The role is responsible for building a stable, scalable and customer-focused Nordic service organisation, while strengthening collaboration with Sales, customers, suppliers and other stakeholders.

Key responsibilities include:

• Operational and direct leadership and development of the Nordic service organisation

• P&L responsibility, budgeting and performance follow-up for the Nordic service business

• Leadership and support of local Service Managers and Service Leaders in daily operations and long-term planning

• Standardisation and continuous improvement of service processes across Denmark and Sweden and preparation for local service presence in Norway and Finland

• Resource coordination and effective utilisation of service capacity across the Nordic organisation

• Development, implementation and follow-up of relevant KPIs

• Overarching responsibility for service contract sales and contract renewals

• Strengthening collaboration between Sales and Service and supporting customer-focused commercial execution

• Development of strong relationships and proactive communication with customers and suppliers

• Supporting digitalisation and automation of service workflows

Nordic leadership with operational impact

The Service Director Nordic will play a central role in developing Ramcon’s service organisation into a more integrated Nordic function. Success in the position requires the ability to combine strategic perspective with hands-on operational leadership while creating clear priorities, accountability and collaboration across countries and functions.

The position offers significant influence on how Ramcon delivers service to customers and organises its Nordic resources. The Service Director Nordic will lead an experienced organisation consisting of service engineers, service leadership and service coordination in Denmark and Sweden and will contribute directly to the company’s continued growth and operational development.

Your profile

The ideal candidate is an experienced service leader with a proven track record of creating results through people, structure and disciplined execution in a technical B2B environment. You understand the commercial importance of a high-performing service organisation and can balance customer needs, quality, resource utilization and financial performance.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to have:

• Experience in leading service teams across multiple locations

• Strong people leadership capabilities and experience in developing managers and specialists

• Experience with P&L responsibility, budgeting, KPIs and performance management

• A structured approach to process improvement, resource planning and operational excellence

• Commercial understanding and experience with service agreements, contract sales or renewals

• The ability to build trust and collaboration across customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders

• A pragmatic and action-oriented leadership style combined with a strategic Nordic perspective

Experience from Life Science, Diagnostics, Laboratory Solutions, Medical Technology or another specialised technical service environment would be considered very beneficial.

Apply now

The recruitment process is carried out in collaboration with the consulting company Compass Human Resources Group. Please submit your CV as soon as possible if you are interested. Please note that all enquiries will be handled with confidentiality and that we will reply to the email address from which you send your CV.

Deadline for application: As soon as possible

Workplace: Ramcon HQ in Birkerød

Reference: 2618.229

Company: Ramcon

_Do you want to shape the future of analytics for the world's largest jewellery brand? Are you passionate about using data, insights, and technology to drive growth, influence strategy, and unlock commercial opportunities? Then you could be the Senior Manager, Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights we're looking for.

_As Senior Manager, Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights, you will play a pivotal role in defining and driving Pandora's global eCommerce analytics agenda. This is a highly visible leadership position at the intersection of analytics, commercial strategy, and digital growth.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across Global eCommerce, helping shape business decisions through data-driven insights and strategic recommendations. Leveraging a deep understanding of digital performance, customer behaviour, and commercial drivers, you will identify opportunities to accelerate growth, optimise performance, and strengthen Pandora's global eCommerce business.

Leading a team of analytics professionals, you will combine strategic thinking, business acumen, and analytical expertise to ensure data remains at the heart of decision-making across the organisation.

**Key Responsibilities

**Commercial insights & business partnering

• Act as a trusted analytics partner to Global eCommerce leadership, shaping priorities and key business decisions.

• Identify growth opportunities across traffic, conversion, customer and product performance, and turn them into clear commercial recommendations.

• Lead deep dives into the key drivers of eCommerce performance and translate findings into actions that move the business.

Forecasting & performance management

• Own forecasting and performance measurement that support commercial planning and trading decisions.

• Define the KPIs and frameworks used to track and steer eCommerce growth.

• Continuously sharpen analytical approaches and decision-making tools.

Analytics strategy & Centre of Excellence

• Define the analytics strategy, priorities and roadmap for Global eCommerce.

• Lead Pandora's global eCommerce analytics community and set the standard for how analytics creates business value.

• Build analytical and commercial capability across the organisation through coaching and knowledge sharing.

eCommerce analytics platforms

• Act as business owner of Pandora's key eCommerce analytics platforms, ensuring they answer the questions that matter most to the business.

• Lead the Centre of Excellence around these platforms, connecting business needs with technology teams and vendor partners.

• Ensure stakeholders can rely on trusted, decision-ready data.

Team leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing analytics team.

• Build capabilities in analytics, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.

• Foster a collaborative, curious and commercially minded culture.

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**We imagine that you bring significant experience within eCommerce analytics, commercial analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, combined with a passion for translating data into business value and strategic impact.

**Furthermore, We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

**

• Extensive experience working within eCommerce, digital, or commercial analytics environments.

• A strong track record of using analytics and insights to influence business strategy, trading performance, and commercial outcomes.

• Demonstrated success partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing decisions through data-driven recommendations.

• Strong business acumen and the ability to connect analytical findings to broader commercial objectives.

• Experience identifying growth opportunities and proactively defining analytical priorities and agendas.

• Experience leading and developing high-performing analytics teams.

• Strong knowledge of digital performance analytics, forecasting, experimentation, and performance measurement.

• Experience acting as business owner of web analytics platforms, ideally Adobe Analytics and Contentsquare or similar digital experience analytics tools.

• Experience setting the analytics agenda and ways of working within a global organisation.

• Experience working in complex, matrixed, international environments.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to structure ambiguous business questions into actionable analytical approaches.

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage and influence both technical and non-technical audiences.

• A continuous improvement mindset and passion for cultivating data-driven cultures.

**We Hope To See That You Are

**

• A commercially minded analytics leader who naturally connects data to business outcomes.

• A strategic thinker who can see the bigger picture while identifying the key drivers of performance.

• Comfortable moving between executive-level discussions and analytical deep dives.

• Curious, proactive, and confident challenging assumptions with data and insights.

• An inspiring people leader and coach.

• A strong communicator who can simplify complexity and translate analytics into actionable recommendations.

• Skilled at influencing stakeholders across all levels of the organisation.

• Collaborative and relationship-oriented.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-paced international environment.

• Passionate about driving business performance through customer, commercial, and digital insights.

**Your new team

**You will join Pandora's Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights team, a critical function enabling data-driven growth across our global digital business.

Working closely with commercial, trading, marketing, product, technology, and analytics stakeholders, you will help shape the future of eCommerce analytics at Pandora and ensure insights play a central role in how we grow and evolve our digital business.

**Additional Information

**

• Global Career Band: 4A

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site: www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion in 2025.

jobs.occupation: Quality Engineer, Automation and IT, at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you’re energized by quality, validation, and complex Automation and IT projects in pharma engineering, we’d love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for an AIT Quality Engineer to join our AIT Project Quality Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, driving, and delivering validation and quality activities within complex Automation and IT projects in the pharmaceutical and life science industry.

You will work as part of multidisciplinary project teams and act as a trusted advisor on validation strategy, GMP compliance, quality risk management, and project quality execution from project initiation through to handover. The role combines hands-on technical validation expertise with project quality management responsibilities, ensuring that deliverables, quality expectations, timelines, and customer requirements are aligned throughout the project lifecycle.

Location Denmark - Kalundborg

Experience Minimum 5 Years

Department AIT Project Quality Management

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As an AIT Quality Engineer, you’ll be:

• Leading CQV and validation activities for automation, IT, computerized systems, and equipment interfaces in GMP-regulated projects.

• Developing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, test protocols, and summary reports.

• Executing qualification and testing activities while ensuring compliance with GMP requirements, industry standards, and customer expectations.

• Collaborating with customers, suppliers, and project teams throughout FAT, SAT, commissioning, validation, and handover.

• Managing validation risks, deviations, compliance issues, and mitigation actions across projects.

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Able to work independently while building strong relationships with stakeholders.

• Comfortable balancing compliance, quality, timelines, and project risks.

• Eager to share knowledge and support the development of colleagues.

• Skilled at communicating complex validation topics in a practical way.

• Motivated by collaboration and delivering high-quality results in project environments.

**What You Bring To The Role

**In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• A B.Sc., M.Sc., or equivalent degree in engineering, IT, life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related field.

• Experience within CQV, validation, GMP, QA, or project quality management in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life science industry.

• Hands-on experience preparing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, and test protocols.

• Knowledge of GMP, GAMP 5, ISPE guidance, data integrity, quality risk management, and validation lifecycle management.

• Ability to advise customers and project teams on validation strategy, compliance risks, and quality-related decisions.

**Life at NNE

**NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

****Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

****Deadline of application is 27th November 2026

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Rebecca Larsen at +45 31 91 88 47.

**Please note:

**

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Still searching for the right opportunity?

**If this position isn’t quite what you're looking for, but you know someone who would excel in this role, please share this job post. And don’t forget to explore our other exciting opportunities — your future role at NNE might be just around the corner! Visit our Career Site

jobs.occupation: PhD positions in Algebraic Hardness and Applications (AHA) at IT University of Copenhagen
jobs.description:
The IT University of Copenhagen invites highly motivated individuals to apply for a PhD position starting in September 1, 2027, or soon thereafter. 

We invite applicants who want to contribute to the IT University's vision of creating and sharing knowledge that is profound and leads to ground-breaking information technology and services for the benefit of humanity. 

Job description
To be eligible to apply for these positions, the applicants are expected to have a good background and passionate interest in mathematics and computer science, demonstrated by having credited relevant courses such as Complexity Theory, Advanced Algorithms, Probability Theory, Real and Complex Analysis, Calculus, and Combinatorics. Or they may be demonstrated by results at the Olympiads of Mathematics or Informatics, or by publication in relevant internationally recognised conferences or journals.

Applicants need to be motivated for doctoral studies; should possess the ability to work independently and perform critical analysis; and additionally, have good levels of communicative abilities and English language skills. The working language of the group is English, and knowledge of English is also fully sufficient to navigate every-day research life in general.

General information
The IT University of Copenhagen (ITU) is a teaching and research-based university specializing in information technology (IT) and the opportunities it offers. The IT University has more than 160 full-time Faculty members. Research and teaching in information technology span all academic activities which involve computers including computer science, information and media sciences, humanities and social sciences, business impact and the commercialization of IT.

Research at the IT University of Copenhagen
Our research is organized through dynamic research groups, centers, hubs, and labs that promote collaboration across disciplines. These units explore complex challenges at the intersection of people, technology, and society, contributing both to fundamental insights and practical solutions. At ITU, we see research as a shared endeavor – open, critically engaged, and rooted in dialogue with academic communities, industry, and the public sector. We actively pursue international partnerships and networks, and our interdisciplinary approach ensures that our research not only advances knowledge but also generates impact beyond academia.

Teaching at the IT University of Copenhagen
ITU currently offers four BSc degrees, six MSc degrees and one professional master’s degree, spanning across these disciplines. ITU's educations are extremely sought after and produces qualified graduates who are in high demand from the job market.

Working at the IT University
Located in modern architecture, a 6-minute metro ride from the center of Copenhagen, the IT University offers an informal working environment, a varied everyday life, and a highly motivated, innovative, skilled, and diverse international faculty, with PhD degrees from more than 20 different countries. The IT University is an equal opportunity employer and prides itself in actively pursuing an improved gender balance among students and among faculty.

Working in Copenhagen
Copenhagen has a solid educational system, a rich cultural life, universal healthcare, good childcare, and well-functioning infrastructure. Copenhagen is consistently ranked among the world’s most livable cities according to the Economist Global Liveability Index. Living and working in Copenhagen will typically be a great experience for you and your family.

Salary and terms of employment
Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Taxation’s agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and job structure for academic staff at universities.

Qualification Requirements
The following qualifications are required:

• 
3-year programme: candidates should have an MSc (or equivalent)

• 
4-year programme: candidates should have a BSc and one year of university studies on Master level

 The applicants will be employed and enrolled at the ITU University for a period of 3 or 4 years depending on the university degree level of the applicant. 

Application
The application and all other documents ought to be in English and must include:

• 
A motivated application (cover letter), including a detailed description of your qualifications

• 
A full CV, including name, address, phone number, e-mail, previous and present employment and academic background

• 
Documentation of academic degrees (copy of degree certificates etc.)

• 
A statement of purpose, which provides evidence of independent thinking, novelty and originality, of the targeted research field matching the project description

• 
Documentation of English proficiency (see link below to the PhD Admission Requirements)

• 
Relevant scientific publications or/and master thesis written by the applicant (Not required but optional)

 Applications without the above-mentioned required documents will not be assessed.

Please read the guidelines for applicants carefully before filling in the application form. You can see the guidelines through this link. 

The applicant will be assessed according to the Appointment Order from the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation of 13 March 2012.

The IT University may use shortlisting in connection to the recruitment process. In case of shortlisting, the Chair of the hiring committee selects applicants for assessment in consultation with the hiring committee after the application deadline. All applicants are notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The shortlisting of candidates for assessment is based on the criteria in the job posting. 

Further information
Questions about the positions can be directed to Professor Nutan Limaye, IT University of Copenhagen, nuli@itu.dk. Early contact with our faculty staff is encouraged.
Questions related to the application procedure may be directed to HR, hr@itu.dk.

Application procedure

You can only apply for this position through our e-recruitment system. Apply by pressing the button "Apply for position" in the job announcement on our website.

The IT University might upon request in the interview process contact 1-2 references.

Application deadline: December 1, 2026, at 23:59 CET.

Applications/enclosures received at ITU after the application deadline will not be taken into consideration. If you submit an application, it is your responsibility to ensure that it arrives before the deadline so please allow sufficient time for the upload of publications and other documents.

At The IT University of Copenhagen, we have an international environment and view diversity as a valuable resource. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive working environment for all our employees and encourage all qualified applicants, regardless of age, gender, religious affiliation, or ethnic background to apply for the position.

As ITU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

jobs.occupation: Two-year postdoc in developing inventory of agricultural nitrous oxide emissions
jobs.description:
The Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University, Denmark, welcomes applications for a postdoctoral researcher position in developing a Tier 3 model-based national inventory of N₂O emissions modelling from cultivation of soils. The position is part of the SmartField project, which is a cross-organizational research project aimed at obtaining knowledge about N₂O emissions from agricultural fields and solutions for mitigation strategies. Additionally, SmartField will develop and deliver an improved methodology for accounting N₂O emissions at farm and national scale.

Expected start date and duration of employment
The position is to be filled by February 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter and is a two-year fixed-term position.

Job description
You will be part of a research environment addressing greenhouse gas emissions and sustainability transition of agricultural systems, with a particular focus on nitrous oxide emissions from agricultural soil aiming to scale emission estimates from the field to the national scale. Your role will primarily involve supporting the development and implementation of a model-based approach for the national of N₂O emissions from diverse agricultural soils, as well as developing the data pipeline. This will include creating and updating spatio-temporal datasets on soils, cropping systems, and field management, and calculating and assessing and comparing the resulting inventories to other approaches. Scenarios will be used to explore how mitigation technologies and management measures could reduce N₂O emissions and to assess the suitability of the proposed Tier 3 modelling framework for Denmark's national N₂O emission inventory. Your work will support a Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) system, enabling transparent, robust and science-based reporting of mitigation progress regarding agricultural field N₂O emission. You will work in close collaboration with colleagues developing and testing process-oriented models, as well as with those responsible for the national greenhouse gas inventory.

Your profile
We are searching for a highly motivated candidate who has:

• A PhD in agronomy, soil science, data science, environmental sciences, engineering, agroecology, biology, or a related field.
• Experience working with models, managing and analyzing large datasets. 
• Experience working with models related to nitrogen/carbon turnover in soil is considered an advantage but is not required.
• Documented experience in scientific writing and publishing in peer-reviewed scientific journals.
• The ability to communicate effectively in English (both written and oral).
• Good collaboration skills and ability to take responsibility to work independently and proactively on the project
Who we are
The position is shared between the Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology under the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University, and it will be hosted by the Land-CRAFT Center at the AU campus in Aarhus.

The Department of Environmental Science is an interdisciplinary department with expertise ranging from physics, chemistry, microbiology, engineering, social science, geography, economics, to policy analysis. Basic as well as applied research are conducted on some of the major challenges facing society, such as pollution and pollution control mechanisms, management of land, soil, water, air and biodiversity, protection of ecosystem services, and climate change. Advisory services within these areas are offered to governmental organizations, non-governmental organizations and companies. The department consists of five sections and currently about 160 staff (including postdocs and Ph.D. students). 

The Department of Agroecology contributes to sustainable solutions to some of the world’s biggest problems within the areas of soil, plants, animals, humans, and the environment. We want to make a difference by contributing to both fundamental knowledge generation and the attainment of sustainable production systems via innovative research, contracted policy advice, and education. We offer professional laboratories, greenhouses, semi-field, and field-scale research facilities, advanced computing capacities as well as an extensive national and international researcher network. The department consists of nine research sections with around 400 highly skilled employees.

This position is hosted by Land-CRAFT - the Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Future, which aims to bring transformational solutions to agricultural systems. Land-CRAFT is a section within the Department of Agroecology. Therefore, there is a strong focus on climate change mitigation and adaptation strategies.

Both departments believe in equality, diversity, inclusion, and creating an attractive work/life balance.

What we offer 
• A collaborative, international research environment that combines high academic standards with an informal and supportive atmosphere. We value accountability, curiosity, flexibility, and teamwork in everything we do.
• An inclusive and respectful workplace culture, where mutual trust, kindness, and professional dialogue are part of daily life. We encourage open communication and develop a cohesive sense of community across teams and disciplines.
• A flexible working environment that supports work-life balance and individual needs.
• An active institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion – in recruitment, career development, and everyday interactions.
• An innovative and meaningful workplace where your work contributes to solving real-world challenges. No two days are alike, and we welcome creative thinking and new ideas.
• Support for international researchers and their families, including Relocation Service and an Expat Partner Programme.
Place of work and area of employment 
The place of work is Aarhus University (LandCRAFT Center), Ole Worms Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C. The affiliation will be with the Department of Environmental Science. However, it should also be expected that there will be work-related and meeting activities at the Department of Environmental Science which is located at Risø in Roskilde.

Contact information
Further information may be obtained by contacting Head of Section Emissions and Atmospheric Modelling, Professor Peter L. Langen (plangen@envs.au.dk +4520618369), Professor Jørgen E. Olesen (jeo@agro.au.dk +4540821659), or Special consultant related to the national emission inventory Mette Hjorth Mikkelsen (mhm@envs.au.dk +4587158579). 

Deadline
All applications must be received no later than November 27, 2026. 

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self. 

Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Role

With a clear strategy of becoming an integrated end-to-end biotech innovation powerhouse, Genmab is directly involved in the commercialization of our products. To further strengthen the Quality Assurance Commercial & Lifecycle team located in Denmark and the United States, we are looking for a Senior Manager, Quality Assurance (QA) to join our Good Distribution Practice (GDP) team in Denmark.

As Senior Manager, QA - GDP, you will play an important role in ensuring quality and compliance across Genmab’s global commercial distribution network. You will have a broad and hands-on role covering storage and distribution activities, vendor oversight and cross-functional projects, working closely with international vendors and partners as well as stakeholders across QA, Supply Chain and Commercial Operations. Auditing is a significant part of the role, and you will conduct GxP audits of external vendors and partners across our global network. The role requires approximately 50% international travel to vendors and partners, primarily in connection with GxP audits. We are looking for an experienced QA professional who is comfortable taking ownership and navigating new or unfamiliar areas. As a Senior Manager, you will also act as a subject matter resource within your areas of responsibility, providing quality guidance and advice to stakeholders and contributing to compliant and risk-based decision-making.

This is an individual contributor role at Senior Manager level. The position is based in Denmark and reports to the Director of QA GMP, Commercial & Lifecycle - Storage and Distribution.

**

Responsibilities**

• Plan and conduct GxP audits of external vendors and partners and contribute to audit planning, follow-up and continuous improvement based on audit observations and trends.

• Take ownership of vendor oversight activities, including vendor risk evaluations, quality agreements and follow-up on the performance and compliance of GDP vendors.

• Independently manage operational GDP quality activities, including external notifications, change controls, deviations and other quality issues involving external partners.

• Participate in and support recall operations for the EU market in collaboration with the global QA GMP team and external partners.

• Contribute to shipping lane validation/qualification and perform GDP risk assessments related to storage, transportation and supply chain operations.

• Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of quality systems, SOPs and work instructions.

• Represent QA GDP in cross-functional and global projects, taking ownership of QA deliverables within assigned areas.

• Perform shipment release and support EU serialization activities.

• Support implementation and maintenance of GDP training.

• Participate in regulatory inspections and internal audits.

• Maintain knowledge of new and updated GDP regulations and guidelines and translate relevant requirements into practice.

• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain, Commercial Operations and other stakeholders to ensure compliant distribution practices.

• Handle and contribute to continuous improvement of Product Complaint intake and investigations.

• Take on new quality topics and assignments as business needs evolve, independently building the knowledge and stakeholder network needed to bring activities forward.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in science or related field.

• You have 8+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, with significant experience within Quality Assurance and GxP. Experience within GDP and commercial distribution is preferred but not required.

• You have solid experience conducting GxP audits and are comfortable acting as an auditor. Audit experience is a requirement for this position.

• You are proactive, curious and comfortable taking ownership of assignments, independently navigating new or unfamiliar areas and finding solutions where the way forward is not predefined.

• You have strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills and can establish effective relationships across functions, geographies and with external partners.

• You communicate confidently in English and are comfortable asking questions, challenging constructively and making quality decisions within your area of responsibility.

• You must already be based in Denmark at the time of application, and you are willing to travel approximately 50% of the time across Europe, the United States, and the rest of the world on a long-term basis.
